journeys.description: Persist onboarding step, dismiss, reload and resume; account evidence stays server owned.
Create an employee profile, persist and launch its thread, and prove its selected profile version/provider are frozen at the approval boundary.
Queue a task through the real orchestrator request handler, prove the deterministic harness stays idle before approval, then approve the frozen input and verify its completed diff/result.
Persist scoped tool-invocation receipts and approval pointers without storing arguments or result bodies; replay and terminal transitions are covered.

Discover owner-selected Gmail message metadata, read only the selected message through an ordinary employee run, then deny unselected and revoked messages before another provider read. All Google HTTP is mocked; no live inbox is accessed.

Use the explicit app-tools Work marker with a server-bound employee session, read chosen Gmail IDs through mocked provider HTTP, retain immutable private draft bytes without constructing a coding delegate, then exercise authenticated download and human review CAS. Frontend transport and review controls are component tested; this is not a live model or browser-backed Gmail journey.

Persist an owner-scoped project and selected source, attach the project to Work intake, freeze a provenance-framed snapshot at approval, edit the project, then prove dispatch and reload retain the approved text. Cross-owner sources and disabled, expired, or deleted sources are denied.
Approve artifact-workspace input, verify requested files, store bytes in the deterministic R2 adapter, and exercise the authenticated download route.
Create and reload a room, persist messages, enforce membership, create bounded handoffs and cancel a lineage.

Verify a signed Slack thread event, explicitly map it to an owner room, preserve source provenance and deduplicate replies, then create a web-authored delivery intent and send it only after configured dashboard approval through a mocked Slack installation/post receipt. No Slack installation, subscription, token, or real message is used.

Bind an exact-message approval to a paired local machine, queue it through the Worker, reject a different machine, then exercise the fake MCP companion and authenticated result path without starting the upstream executable or contacting a peer.

Register a mock HTTPS Streamable HTTP server, discover and review its schema, enable a scoped principal capability, exercise read dispatch and exact-payload owner approval with durable receipts, then revoke access. All transport calls use a local fixture; no external MCP host or credential is configured.
Create and reload a versioned skill draft, preserve immutable versions, review/activate exact text, and exercise the dashboard editor recovery paths.
Exercise deterministic harness failure, review retry, run cancellation fencing, command replay, and durable-state restart behavior where implemented.

Carry all 17 review candidates into PR163: dispatch after Chat, owner-compatible room routing, atomic edits/migrations, origin intent, approval decision races, frozen replay identity, daemon transport/send boundaries, and frontend submission/revision recovery. All provider and peer calls use deterministic adapters.

journeys.blocker: Not executed: this acceptance suite deliberately uses a deterministic local harness adapter; the delegated scope prohibits credential setup and paid/live provider execution, and a synthetic executor is not evidence that a live Sandbox or model provider works.

journeys.description: Run Chromium against the local Wrangler Worker serving the built frontend, with real local Durable Objects, D1, built-in auth, and the supported local-runtime claim/result protocol. Cover onboarding resume, active skill reload, a persisted room/message/handoff, employee creation, exact human approval, local adapter receipt, and artifact download.
journeys.adapter: Temporary deterministic local-runtime adapter using the authenticated pairing and claim/result APIs; returns clearly marked fixture text and no provider call.
